source_review: Hastings 5 September 2012 ASX original pp2,4,5,7,9 covers the Brockman predecessor named Hastings Project near Halls Creek. Its 1.0 Mtpa, approximately 25-year scoping base case uses the 36.2 Mt estimate (27.1 Mt Indicated and 9.1 Mt Inferred) reduced for pit design. The p7 flowsheet distinguishes Dy oxide, Y oxide and remaining RE oxides. The p2 average annual rates of 140, 830 and 590 tpa sum to 1,560 tpa of gross saleable REO products described as 99% pure. Nb and Zr oxides are separate non-REE products and excluded. No product-specific contained TREO grades or annual Nd and Pr amounts were disclosed. The 2026 report gives 41.6 Mt for Brockman and describes beneficiation and metallurgical testwork. It does not reaffirm the 2012 schedule or establish a matched newer annual forecast. Yangibana and downstream hydrometallurgy production is out of scope.
